label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · MATCHDAY 4
headline: A Champions League away record
sub: Most goals ever scored by a team on the road in the competition. Tasos Douvikas got a hat trick.
caption:
🤯 Como won 9–1 at Lens in the Champions League.

That's the most goals any team has ever scored away from home in the competition. Tasos Douvikas scored a hat trick and seven different players found the net. Cesc Fàbregas's side are now fourth in the table.

Are Como the real deal? 👇

#Como #UCL #ChampionsLeague

label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · ISTANBUL
headline: Liverpool led twice and lost
sub: Nyoni and Isak scored. Greenwood, Archie Brown and Vedat Muriqi (79') replied. Liverpool's perfect start is over.
caption:
😳 Liverpool were ahead twice in Istanbul and still lost 3–2 to Fenerbahçe.

Trey Nyoni and Alexander Isak put them in front, but Mason Greenwood's free kick, Archie Brown and a Vedat Muriqi header turned it around. It's their second defeat in four days after losing to Arsenal on Sunday.

What's gone wrong at Liverpool? 👇

#LFC #Fenerbahce #UCL

label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · ATHENS
headline: Valverde wins it in the 92nd minute
sub: Behind twice. Bellingham and Mbappé equalised, then Valverde fired one in from outside the box.
caption:
⚪ Real Madrid were behind twice in Athens and won 3–2 in stoppage time.

Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé equalised, then Federico Valverde fired one in from outside the box in the 92nd minute. Madrid are 4 from 4.

Bellingham is also now the youngest player to reach 60 Champions League games, passing Iker Casillas.

Can anyone beat Mourinho's Madrid? 👇

#RealMadrid #HalaMadrid #UCL

label: UCL · RB LEIPZIG 2–3 MAN CITY
headline: Haaland: 62 goals in 61 Champions League games
sub: His 78th-minute winner was his 13th goal in 9 games against Leipzig, his most against any team.
caption:
🤖 Erling Haaland did it again.

City were pegged back twice in Leipzig before Haaland scored the winner 12 minutes from time. That's 13 goals in nine games against Leipzig and 62 in 61 Champions League games.

City are up to seventh in the table.

Is Haaland the best No. 9 in the world? 👇

#ManCity #Haaland #UCL

label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · AFTER MATCHDAY 4
headline: The top eight
sub: Top eight go straight to the last 16.
caption:
📊 The Champions League top eight after four matchdays.

PSG and Real Madrid are perfect on 12 points, Arsenal are third and unbeaten, and Como are fourth. Liverpool hang on in eighth after losing in Istanbul.

Who finishes top? 👇

#UCL #ChampionsLeague #PSG #Arsenal

label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · PRAGUE
headline: Gyökeres takes his chance
sub: Madueke scored after 9 minutes, Gyökeres added a goal and an assist. Slavia pulled one back in the 90th.
caption:
🔴⚪ Arsenal won 2–1 in Prague and climbed to third in the Champions League.

Noni Madueke opened the scoring, Viktor Gyökeres set it up and then scored the second himself on a rare start. Slavia scored late to make it nervy.

Should Gyökeres start on Saturday? 👇

#Arsenal #AFC #UCL

label: CHAMPIONS LEAGUE · PORTO
headline: Napoli's European nightmare
sub: McTominay equalised, then Porto scored three in the last 20 minutes. Napoli have lost three of four.
caption:
🔵 Porto thrashed Napoli 4–1.

Scott McTominay cancelled out Jan Bednarek's header, but Gabri Veiga, Jakub Kiwior and a late Samu Aghehowa penalty sank the Italians. Napoli finished with ten men and have lost three of their four games.

Can Napoli still get out of the league phase? 👇

#FCPorto #Napoli #UCL

label: NBA · DETROIT
headline: Jaylen Brown's block seals it
sub: 30 points for Brown, 26 and 15 for Embiid. The Sixers are 8–1 and top of the East.
caption:
🏀 First v second in the East went to Philadelphia.

Jaylen Brown scored a season-high 30 and blocked Cade Cunningham's three with 37 seconds left as the 76ers won 112–106 in Detroit. Joel Embiid had 26 and 15.

And LeBron James became the first player in NBA history to make 16,000 field goals.

Are the Sixers the best team in the East? 👇

caption:

That's 85 points in two games against the Cavs in three nights. He went 15 of 19 from the line, and Ajay Mitchell added 23.

label: NBA · MADISON SQUARE GARDEN
headline: 84 points by half-time
sub: That ties the Knicks' record for an opening half. Jalen Brunson had 22 in the first quarter and 33 overall.
caption:

That ties the franchise record for a half, set back in 1988. Jalen Brunson had 22 in the first quarter alone and finished with 33 in a 135–105 win. Chicago have lost six straight.
